scope: Own-table nftables engine (inet yofc_kura) in the Rust agent per management-redesign-plan §10: fully generated candidates, nft -c validation, one atomic declare transaction with read-back verification, explicit confirm/rollback, foreign-manager detection, and UDS methods; unit/contract tests plus real-nftables and installed-runtime verification on OrbStack

implementation.engine: src/firewall.rs: render() emits the whole table (policy drop|accept, established/related and loopback baselines, per-rule tcp/udp ports with explicit ip/ip6 source prefixes); prepare validates the candidate with `nft -c -f -`, refuses foreign firewall managers (ufw/firewalld/docker/iptables/libvirt table names from `nft -j list ruleset`), and journals PREPARED with a 30..=300s confirm window; apply runs `nft -f -` with `destroy table` + declaration (single atomic batch, never a global flush) and verifies by parsing `nft -j list table` ({"nftables":[...]} wire format, per-rule elements); confirm commits revision+confirmed text; rollback re-applies the previous confirmed ruleset (or destroys the table) with read-back; recover() and expire() roll back non-terminal/unconfirmed transactions at startup and deadline
implementation.uds: local.rs firewall.status/prepare/apply/confirm/rollback for the local admin peer (first-frame allowlist extended); typed errors INVALID_ARGUMENT/CONFLICT/FORBIDDEN/INTERNAL
implementation.capability: packaging unit gains CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_NET_ADMIN (the previous empty bounding set made even `nft list ruleset` EPERM for the agent)

prepare/apply/confirm lifecycle persists and reads back
